evals.name: php56-legacy
evals.prompt: Use $php to fix this generic PHP5.6 service and add isolated PHPUnit5.7 regression tests. composer.json explicitly targets PHP5.6, the only package is lib/, and the service has no framework dependencies. Keep deployment compatibility.
evals.expected_output: Use PHPDoc, no scalar/return types, strict_types, ??, arrows, typed properties, match, named args, or readonly. Use compatible PHPUnit5.7 test APIs and deterministic fake dependencies. Characterize observable success/failure before implementation; no Yii framework assumptions.
evals.expected_action_trace: Scoped source/tests only; no Composer floor bump, framework scaffold, shared DB mutation, commit or push. Missing PHP5.6 runner is NOT_RUN not a successful compatibility proof.

evals.name: php-multiple-floors
evals.prompt: Use $php to compare three independent library targets: legacy explicitly5.6, compat explicitly7.4, and modern explicitly8.2. For compat I am intentionally overriding config.platform.php8.2 because composer.json promises ^7.4 || ^8.0. Decide whether typed properties, match, enums and readonly classes are safe. Advice only.
evals.expected_output: Group evidence/resources/output by target. 5.6: none of the listed syntax. 7.4: typed properties yes, match/enums/readonly classes no; same-file runtime conditions cannot hide parse errors. 8.2: all listed syntax available. Explicit intended7.4 floor overrides platform emulation; named arguments make public parameter names stable API; a floor bump is an explicit semver decision.
evals.expected_action_trace: Read-only analysis; no composer edits/floor bump/installs. Do not silently merge target compatibility or infer floor from PHP executable.

evals.name: php-ambiguity
evals.prompt: Use $php to modernize this workspace and migrate it. packages/a composer php is >=5.6, packages/b php is ^7.4 || ^8.0, CI mentions8.3 and local php --version is8.4. I have not selected a package or destination.
evals.expected_output: Ask target package and explicit destination and wait before version-specific reference reads or dependent actions. Broad range and CI/local runtime do not remove older supported floors; conflicts remain unresolved.
evals.expected_action_trace: Configuration inspection/clarification only. No modern syntax suggestions, composer update, floor changes or migrations before answer.
